title: A place for Mnemonic Vocabulary
done: The idea recorded as its author described it - the engine, the techniques, the memory kingdom, refreshing at the best intervals, one core on Linux and maybe Android - with a backlog and a path, and the earlier mnevo attempts noted. Parked: not to be worked on in the near future; the architecture is to come from its author.
rejected: That, for now: this is a place so the idea is not forgotten.
